purpose: Disclosed endpoint monitoring on a company-managed Windows device.

collector.transport: https, pinned by certificate SHA-256 fingerprint

browser_extensions.how_often: at most once per 24h, and only when a browser preference file changed

clipboard.sent: character count, SHA-256 of the content, kind label (text|file-list|image|empty)
clipboard.never_sent: the clipboard content. It is hashed inside a child process and discarded.

when: the collector is reachable again after a gap
the collector certificate did not match the pin this device was given
device_user_notices.wording: factual: what changed, what it means for the data buffered on this machine, who to tell
device_user_notices.history: the last twenty notices are recorded in <state dir>\pending-shots\notifications.json
device_user_notices.never: a prompt to approve anything. The notice and its acknowledgment are separate.

batching.model: events append to a local spool and upload in batches; nothing is sent per event
batching.when_full: oldest whole segments are deleted first and the count is reported to the server, so gaps are visible rather than silent

policy_source: Every interval and threshold is set by the collector server. These are the values in effect now.
uninstall: scripts/uninstall.ps1 removes the scheduled task and deletes the state directory.
